title: Expo and admin brand parity: code checks passed
summary: All 17 brand logo files match Expo byte for byte. Brand regression tests, history tests and scoped website/mobile/learning typechecks passed; live UI and authenticated saving remain untested.

changes.detail: Append verification results for the shared brand catalogue and website brand display, preserving all earlier history.

validation.name: Brand regression tests
validation.detail: 5 tests passed, covering identity normalization, API authorization/persistence, registry overrides, unsafe URLs, and exact parity of all 17 Expo/web logo files.

validation.name: Typechecks
validation.detail: Mobile tsc --noEmit, learning app tsc --noEmit and scoped website tsc using artifacts/brand-parity-tsconfig.json passed. A full root repository typecheck was not run.

validation.name: Website focused lint
validation.detail: No errors. Three next/no-img-element optimization warnings in picker and website mark. Root lint ignores mobile files; mobile lint checked separately.

validation.name: Change history
validation.detail: 6 history archive/interaction tests passed and pre-follow-up manifest check passed with 512 reports.

validation.name: Live UI, authenticated save/upload and native devices
validation.detail: No local servers were listening on 3000/8081/8082. Live visual checks, authenticated brand creation/logo upload and physical-device rendering were not performed. No deployment.

validation.name: Mobile focused lint
validation.detail: ESLint src/lib/product-brands.ts passed from the mobile workspace with no warnings.
